hero.lede: I build web applications end to end: APIs in FastAPI and Django, interfaces in React and Next.js, and LLM and RAG integrations. Today I build SaaS products and integrations for clients in Colombia and the U.S. at Coordenadas.co.

about.title: About
about.p1: I have 2+ years of professional experience building software. I currently work remotely as a Frontend Developer at Coordenadas.co, and before that I was a freelance Junior Backend Engineer for Sibartech Technology SAS, running Django, FastAPI and PostgreSQL in production.
about.p2: At Coordenadas I built Bikans end to end: a payroll and tax withholding platform, in production with two-factor authentication, where employee data is entered once instead of being typed into two tools. I also build plugins and integrations for U.S. clients and maintain the infrastructure on a Linux server with Docker, Coolify and Traefik.
about.p3: I'm in my 10th semester of Systems Engineering at Universidad de San Buenaventura. My co-authored thesis is a multi-agent system that detects IDN homograph phishing domains. I also built the Content Engine, a LangGraph agent that drafts the posts on this blog and publishes nothing without my approval.
about.portraitAlt: Pixel art portrait of Miguel Bonilla wearing glasses, a white shirt and a blue suit

I build and deploy SaaS products, REST APIs and automation workflows, and integrate LLMs, RAG and agents into applications.
